title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
slides: Why is OpenAI softening its data center NDAs?
The company confirmed it will ease restrictions
But critics say the change is mostly cosmetic
Local groups gain leverage in project negotiations
Ask your officials what terms actually changed
thread_text:
1. OpenAI's NDA problem

OpenAI is quietly easing data center NDAs after criticism that communities were gagged. But the company confirms the change while critics call it cosmetic.

2. What actually changed

The company confirmed it will ease restrictions on local officials discussing projects. But the details are vague — and that's the point.

3. Critics: mostly cosmetic

Local groups say the changes are mostly cosmetic, leaving real leverage untouched. The NDA language may still silence key voices.

4. Local leverage boost

But the shift gives local groups more leverage in project negotiations. They can now ask for specifics without fear of retaliation.

5. Ask your officials

Ask your local officials what terms actually changed in those NDAs. If they can't answer, that's your answer.

Critics say the change is mostly cosmetic and leaves leverage untouched.
Local groups gain leverage in negotiations, but only if they use it.

OpenAI just confirmed it will ease NDAs that kept local officials from discussing its data center projects.

That matters if a facility is planned near you and your town can't say what it agreed to. Critics call the change mostly cosmetic 😒 the vague wording may still silence key voices.

But local groups gain real leverage: they can now ask for specifics without fear of retaliation.

Ask your officials what terms actually changed in those NDAs 🗣️ if they can't answer, that's your answer.
